name: @repo/video-ambient
description: A video with a two-pass Ambilight-style glow sampled live from its own frames, with a CORS-safe static fallback.

useCases: Hero video with a colour-matched ambient bloom behind it
Product or trailer embed that feels less boxed-in than a plain player
Background video that should tint the surrounding surface
compositionHints: Give the wrapper a dark, generously padded surface — the bloom deliberately spills far past the video box
Raise gain above 1 so the glow reads as emitted light rather than a colour wash; raise saturation so it bleeds more colour than the source
Pass a poster so the pre-sample and CORS-blocked fallbacks still look intentional
Lower sampleRate, or set glow to false, on long-running background loops
